entities.name: Dawn
entities.description: Determined, inventive young native survivor of Duskmourn.

entities.name: City
entities.description: Forager who revealed allegiance to the Cult of Valgavoth.

events.summary: Dawn spots the returning foragers Rill, Sunset and City and notices City's odd behavior.
events.quote: she spotted the returning foragers Rill , Sunset , and City

events.summary: City reveals his allegiance to the Cult of Valgavoth and monsters breach the Carnival fence; Dawn flees.
events.quote: She turned and ran, desperate to find a way to escape the impending destruction

events.summary: City offers Dawn the choice of joining the cult or death, then leaves.
events.quote: join their cult or face death

events.summary: The Benefactors pull Dawn to safety after she battles a glitch ghost.
events.quote: she was pulled to safety by a group of survivors called the Benefactors
